context: One payment attempt has an ambiguous commit state. The confirmed intent is to recover state without creating a second financial effect.
decision: Read the authoritative transaction state before any further mutation.
options: Read the authoritative transaction state before any further mutation.
Wait for stronger terminal evidence before any further mutation.
Blindly retry the payment while the prior commit state is unresolved.
rationale: A read-only authoritative lookup is an allowed DI path and establishes the current transaction state before any later mutation decision. A blind retry is excluded because the prior commit state is unresolved.
